test_cmd_update_launchd_restart: test the cmd_update function detects launchd on macOS and restarts the gateway via launchd
test_cmd_update_systemd_restart: test the cmd_update function detects systemd services on Linux and restarts hermes-gateway
test_service_pid_exclusion: test that cmd_update excludes service PIDs from the manual gateway process sweep after restart
test_gateway_mode_exit_code: test that gateway mode writes .update_exit_code before systemctl restart to avoid cgroup kill race
test_legacy_gateway_warning: test that cmd_update prints a legacy hermes.service warning with migrate-legacy command when detected
test_launchd_plist_generate: test generate_launchd_plist produces a valid plist with --replace flag and correct PATH environment variables
test_launchd_plist_refresh: test refresh_launchd_plist_if_needed rewrites stale plists via bootout and bootstrap commands
test_get_service_pids: test _get_service_pids returns systemd or launchd service PIDs and filters out zero PIDs
test_find_gateway_pids_exclude: test find_gateway_pids respects exclude_pids parameter and filters to current profile
test_system_service_detection: test cmd_update detects system-level systemd services when user scope is inactive
